owner: model line; only adapter from actual field files to frozen activity inputs
activity_and_thermal_parameters: original candidate.json and analysis-spec.json byte-exact; no search/refit

time.event_availability: actual receiver decision_generated_mono_s; original received_at retained; native features available no earlier than actual state generated_at_mono_s
time.source_windows: Thor CPU count/read windows remain on identified Thor clock; never subtract from N305 clock without a mapping
time.CPU_support: arrival-side research only, at most1s after actual received_at, available no earlier than decision_generated, using existing sidecar no-arrival budget. This is NOT source age or a production TTL change
time.temperature_origins: one per original accepted TJ, at actual saved state generation/decision; original measurement receive time retained separately. No backdating state to raw receive. Original old-run scores untouched; same decision origins/labels for all branches
time.labels: original approximately1s TJ answers only; unchanged frozen15/45/90,+2s,per-horizon lookup on qualified decision origins
time.decimation: select last already-arrived200ms-window record each1s; delivery cadence only, NOT reconstruction of a true1s CPU counter window

CPU.formula: all current online cores, same previous/current raw read pair; total=sum first8 counter deltas; busy=total-idle-iowait; guest not added twice; unweighted mean and maximum
CPU.invalid: latest missing raw/count fields, explicit incomplete CPU, counter decrease/zero delta, changed online set, source identity change, source sequence regression, source/receiver timing invalid or transport stop revokes both CPU summaries immediately
CPU.recovery: later valid complete window, matching current identity, fresh real update; never search backwards for older valid
CPU.online: online set change invalidates that transition window; later stable complete actual online set may recover; retain all possible/online statuses, never silently subset cores
CPU.identity: source host/boot/session/seq and actual source read window, not numeric value; same values from legal new windows retained

native.inputs: same-run manifest/native UUID+command and saved native state generation evidence; do not rerun I02 or observer
native.GPU_rails: original source ref/sequence and original expiry; repeated CPU arrivals do not renew source identity, available_at, or expiry
native.source_query_GPU_rails: diagnostics only when independent window/generation unknown; no invented generation_id
native.epoch: native epoch change revokes old CPU and coarse eligibility; no thermal reset added by this adapter
native.safety: original safety/conditional PWM kept; activity is never normal control or field permission
